text: Over the past 30 days, some visitors expressed frustration with the heavy use of AI in exhibits, describing it as lacking substance and not aligned with Theodore Roosevelt’s legacy. Several noted that the interactive AI features were not accessible to all, such as taller guests, and that the experience felt more like an immersive tech display than an educational one. Crowding was also mentioned as an issue, particularly during visits coinciding with large school groups, which limited access to exhibits. While many appreciated the interactive exhibits and architecture, a number of reviews indicated a desire for more traditional historical content and deeper interpretation of Roosevelt’s accomplishments.

While interactive exhibits were frequently mentioned, there were mixed feelings about how well technology enhanced the experience. Comments also touched on architecture and landscape, with fewer mentions of parking and food services. Overall, the average rating remains high, but attention to visitor flow and content depth could improve the experience.
